sentences.text: I går var Nils på markedet med Marta.
sentences.english: Yesterday Nils was at the market with Marta.

sentences.text: Nils hadde ei veske. Han hadde en bok, en telefon og brød i vesken.
sentences.english: Nils had a bag. He had a book, a phone and bread in the bag.

sentences.text: Så mistet Nils vesken. Han gråt.
sentences.english: Then Nils lost the bag. He cried.

sentences.text: Veska er borte! Jeg har mistet den!
sentences.english: The bag is gone! I have lost it!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Marta sa: «Ikke gråt, Nils. Vi skal finne den.»
sentences.english: Marta said: "Do not cry, Nils. We will find it."

sentences.text: Marta tenkte: «Hvor var vi før?»
sentences.english: Marta thought: "Where were we before?"

sentences.text: Kan du huske det, Nils?
sentences.english: Can you remember, Nils?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Nei, jeg husker ikke. Jeg var hos Ola.
sentences.english: No, I do not remember. I was at Ola's.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: De gikk til Ola. Ola selger epler på markedet.
sentences.english: They went to Ola. Ola sells apples at the market.

sentences.text: God dag, Marta! God dag, Nils!
sentences.english: Hello, Marta! Hello, Nils!
sentences.speaker: ola

sentences.text: Har du ei veske, Ola? Jeg har mistet min.
sentences.english: Do you have a bag, Ola? I have lost mine.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja! Jeg har sett ei veske her. Den lå under bordet.
sentences.english: Yes! I have seen a bag here. It was under the table.
sentences.speaker: ola

sentences.text: Ola fant vesken. Han sa: «Er det din?»
sentences.english: Ola found the bag. He said: "Is it yours?"

sentences.text: Ja! Det er min veske!
sentences.english: Yes! It is my bag!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Nils gråt ikke mer. Han var glad.
sentences.english: Nils did not cry any more. He was happy.

sentences.text: Takk, Ola! Takk, bestemor!
sentences.english: Thank you, Ola! Thank you, grandmother!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Du må huske vesken, Nils.
sentences.english: You must remember the bag, Nils.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Sam hadde sett Nils på markedet.
sentences.english: Sam had seen Nils at the market.

sentences.text: Han ser at Nils er glad. Nils har vesken.
sentences.english: He sees that Nils is happy. Nils has the bag.

sentences.text: Du er glad, Nils! Jeg tenkte at du var trøtt.
sentences.english: You are happy, Nils! I thought that you were tired.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja! Jeg mistet vesken, men Ola fant den.
sentences.english: Yes! I lost the bag, but Ola found it.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Marta tenkte at Nils glemmer mye. Men hun var glad i Nils.
sentences.english: Marta thought that Nils forgets a lot. But she was fond of Nils.

sentences.text: Sam sa at han liker folk på markedet. De er snille.
sentences.english: Sam said that he likes the people at the market. They are kind.

sentences.text: Hos Marta sitter alle i stua. Sam får kaffe, og han besøker henne hver lørdag.
sentences.english: At Marta's everyone sits in the living room. Sam gets coffee, and he visits her every Saturday.

sentences.text: I butikken trenger Sam egg, smør og brød. Han har listen, og han handler.
sentences.english: In the shop Sam needs eggs, butter and bread. He has the list, and he shops.

sentences.text: Marta står opp tidlig, før klokka fem. Hva gjør hun? Hun baker. Om natten sover hun.
sentences.english: Marta gets up early, before five o'clock. What does she do? She bakes. At night she sleeps.

sentences.text: Legen sier: «Du har feber og vondt i hodet. Du må hvile.»
sentences.english: The doctor says: "You have a fever and a headache. You have to rest."
